0.0: I knew #p1012102# was going to send somebody to get that #b#t4031043##k back! She told you I borrowed it, didn't she? Well I didn't! #p1012102# has been 'borrowing' my things for as long as I can remember without bringing them back. I'm holding this cape as collateral!
0.1: Well, if you really need this #b#t4031043##k, return what #p1012102# stole from me, first. Those items were very important to me.

yes.0: Whoa, really? Are you and #p1012102# close? Well, I'm just getting what was originally mine. Please retrieve #b1 #t4001005# and 15 #t4000028#s#k.
yes.1:
And they were so hard to collect! If you can bring me all of those, I'll gladly give you the #b#t4031043##k.
Oh! The #bAncient Scroll#k was probably taken by the Tauromacis.

no.0: Okay. You don't have to pay a debt that's not yours. Anyway, please tell #p1012102# that if he wants to get the cape back, he should return to me the stuff he took from me.

1.0: M-my things! I thought I'd never see them again! Take the #b#t4031043##k, I don't even want it!

item.0: I don't think you collected the items I told you about. I will give you #p1012102#'s #b#t4031043##k if you can bring me #b1 #t4021008#, 1 #t4001005#, and 15 #t4000028#s#k. Good luck!
